name: Bagira M. Holdings Ltd.
summary: Bagira M. Holdings Ltd., through its subsidiary, designs, develops, and sells training and simulation systems internationally. It offers products, such as FORCE-ON-FORCE, JTAC and joint fires, UAV mission simulator, infantry skills trainer, digital sandbox, howitzer crew trainer, and CBRN simulation; and services, including the design, development, delivery, and support of virtual, constructive, and live training systems for mission readiness. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Hevel Modi'in, Israel.
